title: Cycling Ottawa's 200th Anniversary, self-guided
includes: New Giant bike, helmet, lock, map
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
policies: Availability for shows cannot be checked without making a booking. Credit cards will only be charged upon confirmation of show availability
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
2026 is Ottawa's 200th. An historic opportunity to ride the prestigous pathway system at your own pace and distance. Starts on our Rideau Canal doorstep. There are no roads or traffic to negotiate to enjoy the parklands and waterways. See Rideau Canal, Rideau Falls, Hog's Back Falls, Arboretum, Central Farm, Rideau, Ottawa and Gatineau Rivers 

Our community is safe and helpful to visitors.

Easy to navigate pathways follow the 4 major waterways.

Light, easy Giant models in five sizes expertly fitted. Electric assist upgrade available. 

Our personal directions and map are guaranteed.

IT COSTS LESS with no guide to arrange! 

 • Duration: up to 4 hours, 15km -25km
